_doc: Pace profiles for sequence.py. Seconds. pre/post = buffer kept before the first and after the last sound event of a beat; max = the longest a beat of that kind may run; hold.hero_max = a moment marked hero (the product turned side to side, the reveal). min_beat drops slivers. snap = how far a cut may move to land on the quietest 20 ms of sound. fade = audio fade at both ends of every clip (no clicks when clips sit back to back). STEADY is the default: on one phone unboxing the three profiles cut 54 s (relaxed), 43 s (steady) and 29 s (brisk) from the same moments; keep the other two to compare, change a value only on the user's note.
